Performance de la pompe

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Performance de la pompe?

In this glossary, Performance de la pompe refers to: Assessment and monitoring of cargo pump efficiency, capacity, and operation to ensure optimal transfer rates and detect malfunction or wear.

How is Performance de la pompe used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Officier de cargaison à la salle de contrôle : Surveillez les indicateurs de performance de la pompe et signalez tout débit anormal."

Why does Performance de la pompe matter in maritime?

Performance de la pompe matters because it supports clear communication in Cargo contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Performance de la pompe?

Performance de la pompe is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Performance de la pompe belong to?

In this glossary, Performance de la pompe is grouped under Cargo. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

Assessment and monitoring of cargo pump efficiency, capacity, and operation to ensure optimal transfer rates and detect malfunction or wear.

Operational example

Cargo officer to control room: Monitor pump performance indicators and report any abnormal discharge rates.
